plain_text:
City of Portland 
Parks Commission Agenda 
 
 
 
The mission of the Portland Parks Commission is to advocate for the enhancement and stewardship 
of our parks and open spaces. Review and propose projects that impact parks and open spaces and 
recommend action. Foster collaboration among park users and the City. Promotes public access 
and enjoyment. Advocate for public and private funding for parks and open spaces. Enjoy Portland 
for life.
 
Commission Members: 
Alexis Lopez Del Vecchio (Chair), Beth Rabbitt(Co-chair), Donna Gartland, Griffin Bourassa, Jaime Parker, 
John Clark, Kaley Sweeney. Marie Gray, Robert Foster, Sarah Michniewicz (City Councilor), Stephen 
Campbell, Zach Mgoon. 
City Staff: 
Alex Marshall (Parks Director), Jen DeRice (Parks Assistant Director), Jessica Teesdale (PRF Sr. Executive 
Assistant) 
 
 November 5, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
On the first Thursday of the month at 5:00 pm, the Portland Parks Commission will hold a meeting at 
Parks, Recreation, and Facilities, 212 Canco Rd., Suite A conference room.   
 
 
 
The Parks Commission will conduct this workshop session in person. No public comment will be 
recorded at this workshop session. The next public meeting will be held on December 3, 2025. 
 
I. Workshop Outline  
  a. Outreach 
 
  b. Annual Report 
 
  c. Interpretative Signs
